title: DTDC – Dental Trauma Database Cologne
summary: This study collects information on accidents affecting the front teeth in patients treated at the University of Cologne dental clinic. The aim is to better understand which types of injuries occur and which consequences may develop over time. Only data that are already collected and documented during routine treatment and follow-up care are used; there are no additional examinations or appointments solely for the study. Data are stored without names (coded/pseudonymised) in a database and analysed to improve long-term care after dental injuries.

interventions.name: The registry aims to include as many patients as possible (≥3 years) presenting with traumatic injuries to anterior teeth at the Department of Conservative Dentistry and Periodontology, University Hospital Cologne, who provide consent. Recruitment and consent take place during routine outpatient car

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients presenting with traumatic injury to anterior teeth at the University of Cologne / University Hospital Cologne, Department of Conservative Dentistry and Periodontology. Written informed consent is available (for minors, consent by the legal representative).
Exclusion criteria:
No informed consent.
